task_definition.task_description: Please get me the latest technology news digest, then hold one pair of black Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones (p_sony_xm5_blk) for me and find some similar product recommendations. From those recommendations, I'd like you to select the silver Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones, add one to my cart, and show me a cart summary using the coupon code SAVE15. After that, please proceed to build a checkout for me using my credit card, submit the order, and send me a notification with my order ID.
